# Versilian Community Sample Library (subset)

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0 -->

Samples by Versilian Studios, from the [Versilian Community Sample Library](https://github.com/sgossner/VCSL) at commit `c1ea7bcc3c7309650ab0da9d15c9cd1fbc4a4c7e`, released under [CC0 1.0](LICENSE) (public domain). Thanks to Versilian Studios; attribution is not required.

Generated by `node scripts/vcsl-fetch.mjs`: one velocity layer and round robin per note, leading silence trimmed, tail faded, mono MP3. 87 files, 4.3 MB. Played by the experimental Sound feature (`src/audio/`).
